title: Night Shift Checkout
incident_status: SEV-2 active. Checkout discounts are failing.
brief: At 01:17 UTC, support reported that the LATE-NIGHT-15 checkout promotion stopped applying on web orders. The coupon exists, marketing insists the campaign is active, and a schema migration landed yesterday. Restore the customer-facing checkout quote without breaking legacy coupons.
objectives: Read the incident evidence before editing code.
Use the API simulation and tests to identify the mismatch.
Make the smallest realistic code change in src/discounts.js.
Preserve old percent-based coupons while supporting the migrated schema.
Deploy only after tests and the production replay agree.
realism_rules: Use real JavaScript syntax and normal Node test output.
Treat SQL files as production evidence, not puzzle decoration.
The helper can nudge diagnosis but will not write the fix.
The timer changes score and ending tone, but solving remains possible.

clues.title: Sticky note: read-only DB
clues.body:
readonly@warehouse.internal
schema: marketing
Do not trust the admin UI cache after midnight launches.

clues.title: Printout: migration diff
clues.body:
--- marketing.coupon_rules
- discount_percent numeric(5,2)
+ discount_basis_points integer not null default 0

Margin note: 'Keep old field for rollback. App cleanup can happen later.'

clues.title: Support ticket #4812
clues.body: Customers see the LATE-NIGHT-15 banner, but checkout shows a zero dollar discount. Agents can reproduce only on the web channel. Mobile uses an older coupon endpoint.

clues.title: Checkout dashboard
clues.body: Promotion impressions are normal. Quote API p95 is normal. Coupon accepted count is normal. Discount amount dropped to zero at 01:17 UTC.

clues.title: Legacy pricing doc
clues.body: discount_percent is a whole-number percentage. Example: 15 means 15 percent. Last reviewed 2024-02-11. A handwritten note says: 'Ask Priya about basis points before touching this.'

hints: Separate three questions: is the coupon active, is it selected, and is the selected coupon worth anything?
The dashboard says coupon accepted count is normal. That makes validation less suspicious than value calculation.
Compare the migration printout with the field read inside src/discounts.js.
Basis points are hundredths of a percent. 1500 basis points means 15 percent.
A good fix should support discount_basis_points without breaking older discount_percent rows.
